conformance_note: C1-C5 and C7 are met. C1 is met precisely BECAUSE the fields the original campaign never captured are recorded as null with a (U) entry rather than guessed — that is what C1 prescribes for an unknown, so an incomplete report is still C1-conforming as long as it is honest about what it does not know. C6 is met in structure but the theoretical tier is declined with a (U) reason, since the KV geometry needed for a defensible roofline was never captured. Two of those unknowns are worth naming, because they limit how far these numbers travel: the harness's percentile convention was not recorded (§4.3), so the tail figures are internally comparable but not comparable against another site's; no independent local token count was taken (§4.7.1), so the engine's usage accounting was never reconciled and an undetected tokenizer mismatch would move every context-length figure here; and no rung carries an outcome from chapter 7 §7's vocabulary, because with no telemetry-health record a clean rung and a defective one are indistinguishable after the fact — which is exactly why that vocabulary has to be recorded during the run and not reconstructed from it. C8 is not met: no run configs, raw per-request records, engine logs or environment capture were published. Per SPEC 'Conformance', a report meeting C1-C5 but not C6-C8 may be labelled partial. This example is published as partial deliberately, to show what the protocol looks like applied to a campaign that predates it.

hardware.interconnect_inter_node_u_reason: (U) single-node campaign only; multi-node scaling not measured

model.model_id_u_reason: (U) withheld — the model under test was a pre-release checkpoint and its identifier is not ours to publish. Every capacity figure below is reproducible against any MoE of the same total/active parameter split.
model.n_layers_u_reason: (U) not captured. Consequence: the analytic KV model cannot be evaluated for this report, so every KV figure here is the ENGINE-REPORTED value, which the protocol requires be preferred anyway (SPEC 'Formulas'). This is the single most instructive gap in this example.
model.n_kv_heads_u_reason: (U) not captured. This is the field that decides whether per-GPU KV capacity FALLS as TP grows: once tensor_parallel exceeds it, kv_heads_per_rank floors at 1 and effective cluster KV heads grow with TP. Without it the observed TP=1/TP=2 flatness must not be extended to TP=4.
model.head_dim_u_reason: (U) not captured. Third of the three fields kv_bytes_per_token needs; see n_layers.
model.attention_type_u_reason: (U) not captured. Without it the applicable KV formula cannot even be selected, let alone evaluated — see chapter 2, Attention families.
model.global_layer_frac_u_reason: (U) attention type unknown, so not applicable

serving.framework_version_u_reason: (U) not recorded at run time. This alone downgrades the report to partial: a different engine version can change KV pool size and scheduling behaviour, so these numbers are not strictly reproducible.
serving.memory_utilization_u_reason: (U) not recorded. Use ascep.capacity.calibrate_memory_utilization against the engine-reported KV token count to recover it before projecting to any other context length.
serving.prefix_caching_u_reason: (U) not recorded. The most dangerous gap in this report: if it was on and the benchmark reused prompt prefixes, measured throughput overstates production.

scaling.efficiency_over_one_explanation: 1.95x on 2x the GPUs is superlinear, which is physically impossible as a scaling gain. It means the TP=1 baseline was degraded — KV-starved at this context length, forcing small effective batches. The correct reading is 'TP=1 is broken for this workload', not 'TP=2 scales at 195%'. Reported here because catching this class of error is a design goal of the protocol (SPEC, C-rules rationale).

sizing_result.floor_crossover_context_tokens_u_reason: (U) not determined. The floors cross where kv_tokens/ctx/duty_cycle equals the throughput floor; solving it needs the throughput-vs-context curve beyond 8k, which was never measured. At 2,000 tokens the throughput floor binds by 3.1x.

High if the model uses sliding-window or hybrid attention: KV would then grow sub-linearly with context and the long-context KV floor quoted here would be pessimistic.
Only relevant if attention is hybrid; see above.
